svg.title: Disciplined $15,000 bootstrapped AI micro-SaaS budget
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-runway-stack; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Disciplined $15,000 bootstrapped AI micro-SaaS budget; subtitle: Illustrative launch stack paired with cloud/LLM credit grants; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: USD cash outlay; excludes non-cash AWS/GCP/Azure/LLM startup credits that subsidize early compute.; caption: Cloud credit grants subsidize inference COGS, not founder runway; keep >=50% of cash in liquid reserve until MRR covers fixed opex.; stages: label: Entity, IP & DPA setup; value: $1,500; numeric value: 1500.0; detail: LLC/C-corp formation, banking, contractor IP assignment templates, and baseline privacy/DPA docs.; label: Core infra & telemetry; value: $1,500; numeric value: 1500.0; detail: Domains, managed Postgres/auth/observability tiers, and golden-eval testing harness.; label: Scanner & GTM pilots; value: $4,000; numeric value: 4000.0; detail: Technographic/WCAG scanner infra, comparison-page assets, and bounded paid-search intent tests.; label: Liquid runway reserve; value: $8,000; numeric value: 8000.0; detail: Untouched cash buffer protecting against slow B2B sales cycles and credit-grant expiration.
